faqs.question: What is MyFundedFX?
faqs.answer: MyFundedFX (legally MyFunded Solutions, LLC) is a proprietary trading firm founded in June 2022 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It offered Two-Step, Two-Step Max, One-Step, One-Step Max and Three-Step evaluation programs on simulated accounts up to $300,000, partnering with brokers such as Eightcap, ThinkMarkets and Purple Trading.

seo.title: What is MyFundedFX? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: MyFundedFX is a Dallas, Texas prop firm founded in 2022, running Two-Step, One-Step and Three-Step evaluation accounts.

faqs.question: What is the MyFundedFX profit split?
faqs.answer: The standard funded split at MyFundedFX is 80% to the trader and 20% to the firm across One-Step and Two-Step Challenges. Depending on the specific challenge type and account performance, published splits have gone as high as 92.75% for top-tier traders.

seo.title: MyFundedFX Profit Split: 80% up to 92.75% | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: MyFundedFX pays an 80% standard split on One-Step and Two-Step accounts, with top tiers reaching up to 92.75%.

faqs.question: How often can I withdraw from MyFundedFX?
faqs.answer: Two-Step, Two-Step Max and One-Step accounts unlock a first payout 14 calendar days after the first trade on the funded account, then continue on a bi-weekly cycle. Three-Step accounts move faster, with payouts available every 5 days. The minimum payout amount on any account is $50.

seo.title: MyFundedFX Payout Cycle | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: MyFundedFX pays every 14 days on Two-Step and One-Step accounts, or every 5 days on Three-Step accounts.

faqs.question: What withdrawal methods and fees does MyFundedFX use?
faqs.answer: Payouts are available via bank wire, cryptocurrency (ETH, USDT and USDC on the ERC-20 network) or PayPal, each with a $50 minimum. MyFundedFX does not add its own withdrawal commission; card and crypto network charges from third parties may still apply.

seo.title: MyFundedFX Withdrawal Methods and Fees | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: MyFundedFX charges no internal payout fee across bank wire, ERC-20 crypto and PayPal, each with a $50 minimum.

faqs.question: Is MyFundedFX still operating, or has it become SeacrestFunded?
faqs.answer: MyFundedFX rebranded to SeacrestFunded in 2025 and paired the change with a new, separately licensed CFD brokerage arm. As of February 2026 the group announced it was winding down forex/CFD prop-style challenge accounts to focus on that brokerage business, directing traders to request final payouts and refunds. Before opening a new challenge, verify current account status and payout availability directly on the official channels, since terms have changed since the original MyFundedFX rules described in these FAQs.
